content.text: {"id": "mm6309a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed 1996–2010 data from the U.S. Renal Data System (USRDS) and the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS)."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the age-adjusted ESRD-D incidence rates in Puerto Rico increased significantly, from 152.8"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "ESRD-D incidence rates were calculated for the adult population with diabetes overall"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the age-adjusted ESRD-D incidence rates in Puerto Rico increased significantly"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Rates were lower for women than men throughout the period."}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "rates were age-adjusted by the direct method to the 2000 U.S. standard population."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed 1996–2010 data from the U.S. Renal Data System (USRDS) and the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS)."}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Trends were analyzed using joinpoint regression, which uses permutation tests to identify points"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "rates were age-adjusted by the direct method to the 2000 U.S. standard population."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Trends were analyzed using joinpoint regression, which uses permutation tests to identify points"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "each trend in the final model is described by an annual percentage change (APC) with a 95% confidence interval."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Results were considered significant if p<0.05."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "BRFSS data were weighted to represent the noninstitutionalized population in Puerto Rico."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
